title: Vaal Dam
scope: Vaal Dam’s gravity wall and earthfill shoulders, with a 714 m service deck, 60 crest gates, the outlet tower and hoists, and the stepped downstream chute.
axis: +X follows the straight dam crest east-northeast. +Z points into the reservoir and -Z follows the downstream flow.

groundCutout.basis: Clear the concrete chute and crest inside their occupied footprint. Preserve the downstream valley, native approach paving and the independent road bridge.

heightPolicy: Fixed absolute datum 1485.988520375 m. The standard viewer sampler yields 1486.60 m upstream and 1454.10 m downstream. The modeled deck at 1493.3 m and 63 m structural wall depth are exterior approximations. The higher comparison uses the 1487 m storage servitude contour.
limitations: PMTiles supplies the reservoir and tailwater boundaries. The straight crest and outlet position fit the retained OpenStreetMap dam outline. Deck grade, individual gate spacing, foundation and flank sections are exterior approximations.
Both water fixtures preserve native shores away from the wall. The higher comparison uses a reference contour without implying an operating water level.
Scope covers the principal wall and visible outlet structures. Buried equipment, operating releases and the independent road bridge are outside the model.
